author: 69ZeldaFan69
quote: Ocarina of Time’s remake is a masterclass in respect. I lined up at midnight, grabbed the foil edition, and didn’t sleep. The cutscenes are movie-quality and they earn every second. They deepen the story instead of padding it. Extra icing, not filler.Graphically it’s the best thing Nintendo has ever shipped. Epona alone looks stunning, and it runs circles around Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom in raw visual fidelity. Those games are great on their own terms, but they don’t come close to **** Water Temple is shorter and it’s an improvement. They took everything that dragged in the original; movement, camera, lock-on; and made it feel incredible. The rolling, jumping, and targeting are pure joy **** the music. They redid it and somehow only made it better. Every track hits harder.A flawless love letter to a legend. Ten out of ten.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
